checks.ref:
command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
review="$reports/review-specs.md"
added=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- "$review" | tail -1)
base=HEAD
[ -z "$added" ] || base="$added^"
touched=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -vxF "$review" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$touched" ] || { echo "$touched"; echo "the review-specs stage writes nothing but $review - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: R1 misses a scenario, so its fix is incomplete: packages/client/src/test/features/locations/locations_device_time_e2e.feature:42-52 ('The exemplar city keeps the height at <width> px') stores "Moscow" under the Russian interface, waits for 'the zone cities data finishes loading', then checks 'the Moscow card has not moved' via listRow(page, MOSCOW) with const MOSCOW = "Moscow" (locations_device_time_e2e.steps.ts:22,151). Under FR1 the row becomes «Москва» once the data loads, so the step fails, and task 6.3 ('Fix any other failure in the code') would push a fix in the wrong place. R1 and its Fix (D6 / task 6.2) must include it. Also check locations_device_time_unit.feature:16 ('the rows show the offset differences "Moscow −2 ч, …"' with ru and the data loaded, found via world.cardOf(city)).

R1's Fix tells the implementer to add «Белград» and «Лорд-Хау» to KNOWN_CITIES, but locationsE2eHelpers.ts already has a «Белград» entry (lines 45-46) and «Остров Лорд-Хау» (line 56), a different string from «Лорд-Хау». The Fix should reuse the existing entries and check their labels against the zone cities data names.

R5 cites controller/cityDataCache.ts:227-229, which does not exist: the file has 36 lines. The rejected-load drop it describes is at lines 21-24 ('pendingLoads.delete(load); throw error;'). The location must be corrected.
